intent: Deliver an impressive tactile marketing homepage, a deterministic accessible workflow demonstration, and three canonical case pages with optional native-dialog enhancement. Preserve the simple static nginx deployment and truthful content; this iteration is a local preview.

findings.suggested_fix: Add repeatable DOM or real-browser tests that initialize the rendered workflow and exercise both policy choices, sample switching, carried rules, replay, reset, inspector keyboard access, announcements and focus, motion cancellation, and controller cleanup. Include the caller's post-scope CUA regression module and retain its execution evidence; check lifecycle cases that it does not yet cover.
findings.title: Rendered workflow lifecycle has no executable coverage
findings.why_it_matters: The main interactive experience can regress while every current JavaScript test still passes: no test initializes the controller, clicks its controls, or verifies the rendered state, live announcement, focus movement, reduced-motion behavior, cancellation, and cleanup. Those branches implement the stated accessible and cancellation-safe outcome, while tests/workshop-demo.test.mjs imports only workshop-policy.js and therefore proves only the underlying state machine. Add controller-level tests so a mismatch between policy state and the UI users operate is caught before release.

verdicts.reason: KTD1 explicitly requires external CSS and native JavaScript modules. The unchanged CLAUDE.md describes the preceding architecture.
No applicable contract sets a 3,000-line stylesheet limit. Line count alone does not establish a defect.
No applicable contract sets a 1,000-line stylesheet limit. The cited sections do not prove harmful coupling.
KTD4 preserves ordinary canonical-link behavior and permits dialog enhancement. The Next link performing normal navigation violates no established contract.
Frozen tests import workshop-policy.js and never initialize initWorkshopDemo. Rendered state, accessibility, cancellation, and cleanup lack executable controller coverage despite U4 expectations.
The documented --container option enables inventory comparison. Output explicitly reports container:null when omitted, so this check is not silently represented as full container verification.
Slash-form eyebrows belong to the authorized creative direction. The unchanged CLAUDE.md separator convention describes the preceding design.

caller_reported_post_scope: tests/workshop-browser.cua.mjs was added and run through the real CUA Chromium tab against the built container. Seven composed checks cover policy states, carried rules, replay/reset, inspector keyboard access, focus, runtime reduced-motion cancellation, and dialog Escape/Forward/Back. Evidence: docs/audits/eapen-workshop/browser-regression.json. The module is outside this frozen review and should be incorporated to address #6.

assets/social-card.png was converted from JPEG bytes to a real 1200x630 PNG. tests/site-integrity.py gained signature/dimension checks. Caller reports the old staged JPEG fails and the corrected PNG passes. These unstaged corrections are outside this frozen review.

Caller reports seven widths without horizontal overflow, dialog/history and failure/no-JS checks, axe checks, and container allowlist verification. Three throttled mobile loads produced LCP 1052-1088 ms and CLS 0.0465; desktop frame observations reported no frame above 33.4 ms. These are caller evidence, not independent review measurements.
